title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Project Manager Sênior para atuar em um cliente internacional na Colômbia , liderando iniciativas estratégicas de tecnologia e transformação digital em um ambiente dinâmico, com múltiplas frentes simultâneas e forte interação com stakeholders executivos.


A posição é 100% remota , com interação frequente em espanhol e inglês .

O(a) profissional ideal possui sólida experiência em gestão de projetos digitais e tecnológicos ponta a ponta, forte capacidade de liderança, excelente comunicação executiva e maturidade para atuar em ambientes enterprise de alta complexidade.


Será responsável por garantir entregas dentro de escopo, prazo e orçamento, mantendo governança estruturada, relacionamento estratégico com o cliente e alta qualidade nas entregas.


Responsabilidades


Gestão de Projetos:

  • Atuar como ponto focal entre cliente e times internos
  • Planejar, executar e garantir a entrega dos projetos com sucesso
  • Gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento e alocação de recursos
  • Monitorar riscos, dependências e indicadores de desempenho
  • Controlar forecast financeiro e planejamento de capacidade

Liderança e Coordenação:

  • Liderar times multifuncionais (tecnologia e negócio)
  • Garantir alinhamento entre áreas técnicas e stakeholders executivos
  • Conduzir cerimônias, rituais de governança e reuniões estratégicas
  • Promover ambiente colaborativo e orientado a resultados

Comunicação e Stakeholders:

  • Gerenciar expectativas do cliente com postura consultiva
  • Elaborar e apresentar status reports executivos
  • Facilitar tomadas de decisão com base em dados e indicadores
  • Atuar diretamente com stakeholders internacionais

Gestão de Riscos e Problemas:

  • Identificar, analisar e mitigar riscos do projeto
  • Resolver impedimentos e conflitos entre áreas
  • Estruturar planos de ação para issues críticas
  • Atuar rapidamente em cenários de desvio de prazo ou escopo

Competências Técnicas:

  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de projetos digitais ou tecnológicos
  • Forte conhecimento em metodologias de gestão (PMBOK, Agile, Scrum, modelo híbrido)
  • Experiência com gestão de orçamento, forecast e planejamento financeiro
  • Vivência com governança e reporting executivo
  • Capacidade técnica para dialogar com times de arquitetura, integrações e soluções enterprise
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos
  • Gestão de múltiplos projetos simultaneamente

Diferenciais:

  • Certificação PMP ou equivalente
  • Experiência com clientes internacionais
  • Vivência em ambientes enterprise de alta complexidade

Idiomas (Obrigatório)

  • Espanhol avançado
  • Inglês avançado
  • Experiência conduzindo reuniões e apresentações em ambos os idiomas



A OSF Digital é uma consultoria global especializada em transformação digital, com forte atuação em tecnologia, dados e experiência do cliente.

Atuamos em mais de 30 países e somos um dos maiores parceiros Salesforce do mundo. Já nascemos no modelo remoto — esse formato faz parte da nossa cultura e está totalmente consolidado.

Nosso foco é desenvolvimento contínuo, crescimento técnico e evolução profissional.



Se você é um(a) Project Manager com forte presença executiva, alta capacidade de liderança e experiência internacional, queremos conhecer você.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (React / Python / Go or Node.js or Java)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (React / Python / Go or Node.js or Java) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this role, you'll help build the core platform that enables power utilities to move from legacy systems to an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Strong background in React
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Remote Chemistry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Chemistry Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Chemical Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing chemistry-centered discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated data, identify chemical relationships, infer reaction rules and molecular behaviors, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes under varying conditions. The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in chemistry, quantitative analysis, and scientific methodology to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.


What does day-to-day look like

  • Designed chemistry-based reasoning scenarios using experimental results, molecular data, and simulated chemical systems.
  • Authored multi-step tasks involving reaction analysis, chemical property inference, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning.
  • Developed evaluation problems focused on pattern discovery, reaction mechanisms, model selection, and scientific consistency checks.
  • Created deterministic solutions, reference explanations, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in chemistry, chemical research, scientific computing, laboratory analysis, or related analytical fields.
  • Applied strong knowledge of chemical principles, scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, and data interpretation.
  • Utilized expertise in experimental design, reaction mechanisms, stoichiometry, thermodynamics, kinetics, or simulation-based analysis.
  • Communicated complex chemical concepts, assumptions, and findings through clear and structured documentation.
  • Evaluated scientific reasoning with exceptional attention to detail, logical consistency, and reproducible outcomes.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Remote Physics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Scientific Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and enhance the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing data-driven scientific discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated observations, identify patterns, infer governing laws, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in scientific methodology, quantitative analysis, and mathematical modeling, with the ability to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Designed scientific reasoning scenarios using experimental, observational, or simulated datasets.
  • Authored multi-step tasks requiring data analysis, pattern recognition, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning.
  • Developed evaluation problems focused on law discovery, model selection, consistency checking, and hypothesis validation.
  • Created reference solutions, deterministic answers, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in physics domain.
  • Applied strong knowledge of scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, data analysis, and experimental methodologies.
  • Utilized expertise in mathematical modeling, parameter estimation, dimensional analysis, and simulation-based problem solving.
  • Communicated complex scientific concepts, assumptions, and solutions clearly through structured documentation.
  • Evaluated reasoning quality with strong attention to logical consistency, ambiguity control, and reproducible outcomes.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Remote Physics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Scientific Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and enhance the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing data-driven scientific discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated observations, identify patterns, infer governing laws, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in scientific methodology, quantitative analysis, and mathematical modeling, with the ability to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Designed scientific reasoning scenarios using experimental, observational, or simulated datasets.
  • Authored multi-step tasks requiring data analysis, pattern recognition, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning.
  • Developed evaluation problems focused on law discovery, model selection, consistency checking, and hypothesis validation.
  • Created reference solutions, deterministic answers, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in physics domain.
  • Applied strong knowledge of scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, data analysis, and experimental methodologies.
  • Utilized expertise in mathematical modeling, parameter estimation, dimensional analysis, and simulation-based problem solving.
  • Communicated complex scientific concepts, assumptions, and solutions clearly through structured documentation.
  • Evaluated reasoning quality with strong attention to logical consistency, ambiguity control, and reproducible outcomes.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Remote Chemistry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Chemistry Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. The Chemical Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing chemistry-centered discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated data, identify chemical relationships, infer reaction rules and molecular behaviors, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes under varying conditions. The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in chemistry, quantitative analysis, and scientific methodology to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.

  • Created deterministic solutions, reference explanations, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in chemistry, chemical research, scientific computing, laboratory analysis, or related analytical fields.
  • Applied strong knowledge of chemical principles, scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, and data interpretation.
  • Utilized expertise in experimental design, reaction mechanisms, stoichiometry, thermodynamics, kinetics, or simulation-based analysis.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About MasterPro


MasterPro Installs Corp is a licensed appliance delivery and installation company operating in different States. We are an authorized installer for major national retail partners and operate a mixed field workforce across multiple markets. We move fast, hold ourselves to high performance standards, and are building the financial infrastructure to match our growth.


About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager who has worked inside field service, home services, trades, or contractor-based businesses — someone who understands what job costing actually means, knows how to read a P&L in an operations-heavy company, and isn't intimidated by multi-state complexity. This is a hands-on role where you will own the numbers from end to end.


What You'll Do


Financial Reporting & Controls


  • Own the full monthly close process including journal entries, P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements
  • Prepare and deliver monthly financial reports and variance analysis to the CEO and department leads
  • Maintain the general ledger and ensure accuracy across all accounts
  • Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations
  • Manage day-to-day financial operations across QuickBooks Online, Bill.com, Gusto, and Square Payroll and others

    • KPI Reporting & Performance Analytics


    • Design and own individual KPI dashboards and scorecards for every professional in the company — field and office
    • Build reporting frameworks that translate operational metrics (installs completed, damage claims, survey scores, efficiency rates) into financial performance indicators
    • Produce weekly and monthly KPI reports distributed to team leads and the CEO
    • Partner with operations to align field performance data with job-level cost outcomes
    • Continuously refine reporting as the team scales into new markets


    Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow


    • Lead the annual budgeting process and monthly rolling forecasts
    • Manage and present 13-week cash flow forecasts to support operational decision-making
    • Analyze per-install job costing and track margin by market, job type, and crew
    • Monitor fleet and operational expenses and identify cost-reduction opportunities


    Multi-State Compliance & Tax


    • Coordinate multi-state payroll tax compliance across CA, OR, LA, TX, and WA
    • Support state business license renewals, sales tax obligations, and regulatory filings across all active markets
    • Serve as internal point of contact for external CPAs, auditors, and any fractional CFO support
    • Maintain workers' comp classification accuracy across W-2 and subcontractor workforce structures


    Systems & Process


    • Manage and improve financial systems and workflows including QuickBooks Online, Bill.com, Microsoft Power BI, and Monday.com
    • Implement financial policies and internal controls that scale with the business
    • Train and support office staff on financial procedures and systems


    What We're Looking For


    Experience


    • 5+ years in finance, accounting, or FP&A — with at least 2 years inside a home services, field services, trades, contracting, or installation company in the US
    • Demonstrated experience building KPI reports and individual performance scorecards, not just company-level financials
    • Hands-on background in job costing, per-unit margin analysis, and field workforce financial management
    • Experience managing finances across multiple states including payroll tax and compliance
    • Familiarity with contractor vs. W-2 cost structures and the financial implications of each


    Skills & Tools


    • Expert-level proficiency in QuickBooks Online
    • Experience with Microsoft Power BI or equivalent business intelligence tools (Tableau, Looker, etc.)
    • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets — you build models, not just read them
    • Experience with Bill.com, Gusto, Square Payroll, or equivalent payroll and AP platforms
    • Strong communicator who can translate financial data into plain language for non-finance leaders

    Education

    • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field required
    • CPA or CMA preferred but not required — real-world experience in the trades and services space matters more to us


    What Sets the Right Candidate Apart


    You've sat inside a company where trucks roll every morning and jobs are measured by the install, not the quarter. You know what it takes to hold a distributed field team financially accountable. You've built a report from scratch that a field supervisor could actually use. You don't wait for someone to tell you the numbers are off — you already know before the meeting starts.


    What We Offer


    • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
    • Direct line to and collaboration with the CEO
    • PTO
    • Room to grow into a senior leadership role as the company scales


    To Apply


    Send your resume and a short note (3–5 sentences) about your experience in home services, trades, or installation businesses to  . Applications without industry context will be deprioritized.

The IT Project Manager is responsible for leading strategic and complex technology initiatives across Infrastructure, Enterprise Applications, ERP, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Digital Transformation, Data & Analytics, and Business Systems.

This role requires a highly experienced professional capable of driving project execution from business case definition through deployment and operational transition, ensuring measurable business outcomes, technical excellence, financial control, and stakeholder alignment.

The Project Manager is expected to actively challenge assumptions, influence decisions, mitigate risks, and lead multidisciplinary teams toward successful delivery.


Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead medium to large-scale IT projects from initiation through closure.
  • Define and manage project scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resources.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans and execution roadmaps.
  • Drive project governance and decision-making processes.
  • Ensure successful delivery of projects on time, within budget, and meeting quality expectations.
  • Coordinate project transition to support and operations teams.


Infrastructure & Technology Projects

Lead projects involving:

  • Data Centers
  • Network Transformation
  • Cloud Migration Programs
  • Cybersecurity Initiatives
  • Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity
  • End User Computing
  • Infrastructure Modernization
  • Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Enterprise Collaboration Platforms


Enterprise Applications & ERP

Manage projects involving:

  • SAP S/4HANA implementations and upgrades
  • ERP deployments and rollouts
  • Financial systems implementation
  • Manufacturing and Supply Chain systems
  • HR and Payroll platforms
  • CRM solutions
  • Enterprise integrations
  • Business applications modernization


Financial & Business Management

  • Build and manage project budgets and forecasts.
  • Perform cost-benefit analysis and ROI evaluations.
  • Support business case development.
  • Monitor project financial performance.
  • Identify optimization opportunities to maximize value delivery.


Risk & Governance Management

  • Identify project risks and mitigation strategies.
  • Manage issues, escalations, and decision logs.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards.
  • Ensure adherence to cybersecurity and data protection requirements.
  • Conduct project health assessments and executive reviews.


Stakeholder Management

  • Engage executive leadership and business sponsors.
  • Facilitate decision-making forums.
  • Manage cross-functional and international teams.
  • Build consensus among technical and business stakeholders.
  • Present project status and recommendations to senior leadership.


Vendor & Contract Management

  • Manage third-party vendors and implementation partners.
  • Evaluate vendor performance.
  • Negotiate project deliverables and milestones.
  • Ensure contractual compliance and service quality.


Required Education

Bachelor's Degree in one of the following areas:

  • Information Technology
  • Computer Science
  • Information Systems
  • Software Engineering
  • Computer Engineering
  • Telecommunications Engineering
  • Business Administration with IT specialization

Preferred

Master's Degree or MBA in:

  • Project Management
  • Technology Management
  • Business Administration (MBA)
  • Digital Transformation
  • Information Technology Management


Required Professional Experience

Mandatory

  • Experience in Information Technology.
  • Experience managing complex IT projects.
  • Proven experience leading multinational or regional projects.
  • Experience managing high project budgets
  • Experience managing cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
  • Experience working in enterprise environments with structured governance.
  • Advanced English

Strongly Preferred

  • Automotive industry experience.
  • Manufacturing industry experience.
  • Experience supporting global organizations.
  • Experience in digital transformation programs.


Technical Skills

Project Management

  • PMI / PMBOK
  • Agile Frameworks
  • Scrum
  • Kanban
  • Hybrid Delivery Models
  • Waterfall

Infrastructure

  • Cloud Computing (Azure, AWS, GCP)
  • Network Architecture
  • Data Centers
  • Cybersecurity
  • Disaster Recovery
  • Business Continuity

Enterprise Systems

  • SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA
  • ERP Implementations
  • Financial Systems
  • Enterprise Integrations
  • Middleware Platforms

Tools

  • Microsoft Project
  • Jira
  • Azure DevOps
  • Confluence
  • ServiceNow
  • Power BI
  • Smartsheet


Certifications

Required (at least one)

  • PMP – Project Management Professional
  • PRINCE2 Practitioner

Preferred

  • PMI-ACP
  • Scrum Master (CSM or PSM)
  • ITIL Foundation
  • SAFe Agilist
  • Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner


Additional Information

  • CLT contract
  • Remote work

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

As an Accounting Analyst, you’ll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You’ll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments.


You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.).
  • Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa).
  • Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations.
  • Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures.
  • Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency.
  • Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS).
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings.
  • Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil.
  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus.
  • Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Third Interview: A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Artificial Intelligence Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Senior AI/Backend Engineer

Remote – Brazil - Remote

Builds the AI co-pilot backends (two chat services).

title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

title: Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join us at ORION THE LAB to build the future of physical AI and robotics!

We collect and prepare real-world video data used to train physical-AI and robotics models for international clients. We are launching a high-volume egocentric video-capture project in Brazil and Argentina and need a local Operations Manager to build, manage, and scale a local team of contributors on the ground.

If you have a strong local network, experience managing distributed field workers, and thrive on owning quality-driven operations, we want to hear from you.



Role Overview

As the Operations Manager, you are the key executor on the ground. You are entirely responsible for quality and delivery—not just managing a headcount. You will recruit contributors, audit technology compatibility, train teams on capture rules, run QA pre-checks, and handle local payouts


.

What You Will Do

  • Recruit & Scale : Source continuous data contributors who meet device requirements. Scale your team to keep up with growing project demands
  • Onboard & Setup : Install the dedicated project app, create user accounts under verified tracking emails, and correctly configure the organization codes
  • Train for Excellence: Train contributors on strict egocentric filming rules (headset tracking, 45° downward angles, landscape view, 1080p+ resolution, organic and completed home tasks
  • Strict Quality Assurance : Run pre-upload QA checks on all incoming footage. Filter out shaky, tilted, poorly lit, or repetitive videos to maintain a strict 95% client qualification rat
  • Privacy Enforcement: Guard local privacy rules; strictly prohibit filming non-consenting individuals, cooking, or private screens/document
  • Manage Payouts : Distribute payments to your team weekly using per-email qualified data logs and maintain localized accounting records


Compensation & Scale

  • Earning Structure : You are paid $3.00 USD per qualified hour of footage accepted by the client's QA team
  • Team Payout: You pay your local contributors $2.00 USD per qualified hour
  • Your Net Share : Your coordination fee is $1.00 USD per qualified hour

The Opportunity : Starts with a 500-hour test pilot. Upon successful completion, the project scales to an ongoing order of up to 10,000 qualified hours per month ($10,000 USD/month total coordination potential).


Profile Requirements

  • Location : Based in Argentina or Brazil with an expansive, functional network in a major populous city
  • Proven Experience : Direct history recruiting and managing distributed field operations (e.g., census/survey teams, brand promoters, mystery shoppers, or gig/delivery fleets
  • Billing Capacity : Legally able to issue local invoices (factura or cuenta de cobro)
  • Payment Setup : Ready to receive corporate funds and distribute team payments via Mercado Pago, Nequi, Daviplata, or an equivalent digital network
  • Communication : Highly organized and exceptionally fast over WhatsApp. Fluent in Spanish with functional English capabilities.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join us at ORION THE LAB to build the future of physical AI and robotics!

We collect and prepare real-world video data used to train physical-AI and robotics models for international clients. We are launching a high-volume egocentric video-capture project in Brazil and Argentina and need a local Operations Manager to build, manage, and scale a local team of contributors on the ground.

If you have a strong local network, experience managing distributed field workers, and thrive on owning quality-driven operations, we want to hear from you.



Role Overview

As the Operations Manager, you are the key executor on the ground. You are entirely responsible for quality and delivery—not just managing a headcount. You will recruit contributors, audit technology compatibility, train teams on capture rules, run QA pre-checks, and handle local payouts


.

What You Will Do

  • Recruit & Scale : Source continuous data contributors who meet device requirements. Scale your team to keep up with growing project demands
  • Onboard & Setup : Install the dedicated project app, create user accounts under verified tracking emails, and correctly configure the organization codes
  • Train for Excellence: Train contributors on strict egocentric filming rules (headset tracking, 45° downward angles, landscape view, 1080p+ resolution, organic and completed home tasks
  • Strict Quality Assurance : Run pre-upload QA checks on all incoming footage. Filter out shaky, tilted, poorly lit, or repetitive videos to maintain a strict 95% client qualification rat
  • Privacy Enforcement: Guard local privacy rules; strictly prohibit filming non-consenting individuals, cooking, or private screens/document
  • Manage Payouts : Distribute payments to your team weekly using per-email qualified data logs and maintain localized accounting records


Compensation & Scale

  • Earning Structure : You are paid $3.00 USD per qualified hour of footage accepted by the client's QA team
  • Team Payout: You pay your local contributors $2.00 USD per qualified hour
  • Your Net Share : Your coordination fee is $1.00 USD per qualified hour

The Opportunity : Starts with a 500-hour test pilot. Upon successful completion, the project scales to an ongoing order of up to 10,000 qualified hours per month ($10,000 USD/month total coordination potential).


Profile Requirements

  • Location : Based in Argentina or Brazil with an expansive, functional network in a major populous city
  • Proven Experience : Direct history recruiting and managing distributed field operations (e.g., census/survey teams, brand promoters, mystery shoppers, or gig/delivery fleets
  • Billing Capacity : Legally able to issue local invoices (factura or cuenta de cobro)
  • Payment Setup : Ready to receive corporate funds and distribute team payments via Mercado Pago, Nequi, Daviplata, or an equivalent digital network
  • Communication : Highly organized and exceptionally fast over WhatsApp. Fluent in Spanish with functional English capabilities.

title: Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Account Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Icon makes winning ads and branded content for some of the fastest-growing DTC and enterprise companies in the world. We're now launching our managed creative/ads services and looking to scale our team aggressively. We're on a mission to become a trillion dollar generational company.


Overview

We're hiring an Account Manager to own our client relationships end-to-end. You'll be the face of Icon to the brands we work with — making sure they're getting results, renewing, and expanding, while keeping our creative team pointed at the highest-impact work every single day. You'll be part relationship-builder, part strategist — we'll rely on you to keep clients happy, informed, and growing their spend with us. At the same time, you'll be the connective tissue between the client and our creative pipeline — as an agency producing tens of thousands of ads per month, you'll make sure every client's goals translate cleanly into briefs, deliverables, and performance. You are the person who makes sure clients stay, win, and scale with Icon.


What You'll Own

1) Client Relationships & Retention (Trust + Renewals)

Own the day-to-day relationship: you're the primary point of contact and the person clients trust.

Run regular check-ins, updates, and reviews so clients always know where things stand. Set clear expectations and manage them proactively (no surprises, no silence).

Catch dissatisfaction and churn risk early — and drive the save before it's a cancellation.

Hit renewal and retention targets across your book of business.


2) Account Growth (Expansion + Spend)

Identify upsell and expansion opportunities (more creators, more ad volume, new product lines). Build the case for growth with performance data and clear ROI.

Coordinate with sales/leadership to close expansions and renewals.

Grow each account's spend over time by proving Icon's value continuously.

Turn happy clients into references, case studies, and referrals.


3) Execution & Cross-functional Coordination (Briefs + Performance)

Translate client goals into clear, actionable briefs for the creative team.

Coordinate priorities with Creative Ops so client work ships on time and at quality.

Track and report on creative performance (delivery, throughput, results) back to clients.

Own escalations: when something slips, you drive the fix across teams.

Work closely with Ops and Engineering to remove recurring friction in the client workflow.


You're a Fit If You…

Have experience in account management / client success / agency relationship management (especially high-volume or performance-driven environments).

Can build trust fast and manage clients with both warmth and high standards.

Are commercially sharp: you spot growth opportunities and know how to close them.

Are obsessive about follow-through, communication, and never letting a client feel ignored.

Can translate messy client needs into clear requirements for the creative and eng teams.

title: Senior IT Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior IT Project Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The IT Project Manager is responsible for leading strategic and complex technology initiatives across Infrastructure, Enterprise Applications, ERP, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Digital Transformation, Data & Analytics, and Business Systems.

This role requires a highly experienced professional capable of driving project execution from business case definition through deployment and operational transition, ensuring measurable business outcomes, technical excellence, financial control, and stakeholder alignment.

The Project Manager is expected to actively challenge assumptions, influence decisions, mitigate risks, and lead multidisciplinary teams toward successful delivery.


Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead medium to large-scale IT projects from initiation through closure.
  • Define and manage project scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resources.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans and execution roadmaps.
  • Drive project governance and decision-making processes.
  • Ensure successful delivery of projects on time, within budget, and meeting quality expectations.
  • Coordinate project transition to support and operations teams.


Infrastructure & Technology Projects

Lead projects involving:

  • Data Centers
  • Network Transformation
  • Cloud Migration Programs
  • Cybersecurity Initiatives
  • Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity
  • End User Computing
  • Infrastructure Modernization
  • Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Enterprise Collaboration Platforms


Enterprise Applications & ERP

Manage projects involving:

  • SAP S/4HANA implementations and upgrades
  • ERP deployments and rollouts
  • Financial systems implementation
  • Manufacturing and Supply Chain systems
  • HR and Payroll platforms
  • CRM solutions
  • Enterprise integrations
  • Business applications modernization


Financial & Business Management

  • Build and manage project budgets and forecasts.
  • Perform cost-benefit analysis and ROI evaluations.
  • Support business case development.
  • Monitor project financial performance.
  • Identify optimization opportunities to maximize value delivery.


Risk & Governance Management

  • Identify project risks and mitigation strategies.
  • Manage issues, escalations, and decision logs.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards.
  • Ensure adherence to cybersecurity and data protection requirements.
  • Conduct project health assessments and executive reviews.


Stakeholder Management

  • Engage executive leadership and business sponsors.
  • Facilitate decision-making forums.
  • Manage cross-functional and international teams.
  • Build consensus among technical and business stakeholders.
  • Present project status and recommendations to senior leadership.


Vendor & Contract Management

  • Manage third-party vendors and implementation partners.
  • Evaluate vendor performance.
  • Negotiate project deliverables and milestones.
  • Ensure contractual compliance and service quality.


Required Education

Bachelor's Degree in one of the following areas:

  • Information Technology
  • Computer Science
  • Information Systems
  • Software Engineering
  • Computer Engineering
  • Telecommunications Engineering
  • Business Administration with IT specialization

Preferred

Master's Degree or MBA in:

  • Project Management
  • Technology Management
  • Business Administration (MBA)
  • Digital Transformation
  • Information Technology Management


Required Professional Experience

Mandatory

  • Experience in Information Technology.
  • Experience managing complex IT projects.
  • Proven experience leading multinational or regional projects.
  • Experience managing high project budgets
  • Experience managing cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
  • Experience working in enterprise environments with structured governance.
  • Advanced English

Strongly Preferred

  • Automotive industry experience.
  • Manufacturing industry experience.
  • Experience supporting global organizations.
  • Experience in digital transformation programs.

  • Waterfall

title: Analista de Governança de Dados Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Governança de Dados Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Governança de Dados Sênior para atuar na evolução da maturidade de dados da companhia, liderando iniciativas estratégicas relacionadas à qualidade, catálogo, metadados, acessos e políticas de dados.

Procuramos alguém com visão ampla de governança, perfil executor, comunicação excelente e forte capacidade de transformar estratégia em processos concretos.


Principais responsabilidade

  • Desenvolver e implementar processos de governança de dados (catálogo, qualidade, MDM e metadados)
  • Criar políticas, normas e procedimentos de dados;
  • Liderar melhorias em ferramentas de catálogo de dados;
  • Implementar iniciativas de Data Qualit y em ambientes transacionais e plataforma de dados
  • Estruturar e acompanhar indicadores e processos de governança;
  • Liderar workshops, treinamentos e disseminação da cultura data-driven;
  • Atuar com gestão de acessos a dados em Data Lake;
  • Conduzir POCs e testes de ferramentas de mercado;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas técnicas, negócios e times estratégicos;
  • Atuar em ambiente ágil (Jira / Scrum / Kanban / SAFe)


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida (5+ anos) em Governança de Dados;
  • Vivência com catálogo de dados, qualidade, MDM e stewardshi;
  • Conhecimento em linhagem, data discovery e gestão de acessos;
  • Experiência em processos de ingestão de dados;
  • Excelente comunicação e perfil consultivo;
  • Capacidade analítica e senso de priorização;
  • Autonomia e perfil executor


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com migração para cloud (AWS)
  • SQL intermediário
  • Python intermediário
  • Vivência com Databricks e ambientes Lakehouse
  • Governança aplicada a dados não estruturados.

title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

As an Accounting Analyst, you’ll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You’ll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments.


You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.).
  • Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa).
  • Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations.
  • Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures.
  • Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency.
  • Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS).
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings.
  • Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil.
  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus.
  • Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Third Interview: A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

Location: Remote (Brazil / Mexico / Costa Rica)

Employment Type: Contract

  • Experience in Agile/Scrum environments.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in media technology, media operations, or technical support.

title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;
